operative_sections_inspected.quote: Every TRSO version, whether the baseline or a later change (delta), is signed off by ER, Quality and Purchase.

Every change to piece price or tooling/one-time cost is approved by Finance Controller, Program Manager and Purchase. Change class (Section 5) sets the authority level and SLA. It never removes one of these three functions.
Nomination is signed off by Quality, ER and the Program Manager; Finance is informed after nomination. Purchase compiles and owns the nomination file.
When the design changes, the new price is the nominated baseline plus the sum of the deltas of the affected modules, calculated at ARC rates. Only modules that have no ARC rate are negotiated.
G2: Shortlist passes the quality-system gating criteria and the minimum score
R3: Finance, Quality, ER, PM (Purchase owns the file)
R1 at functional-lead level + R2 at delegated level: Finance Controller (commodity), PM, Purchase Manager
R1 + R2 at section-head level: Finance Controller, Program Manager, Purchase Senior Manager
R1 + R2 at head level: Head Finance Controlling, Head of Program, Purchase Head. Escalated to the CPO if re-sourcing
FP3 Delta-only re-pricing. Margin, overheads and rates are locked. Only the delta is discussed, and M8 is never re-opened.

FP6 Proceed-at-risk. For Class B or C changes on the program's critical path, Finance Controller, PM and Purchase (that is, R2 at the CR's class level) may approve a provisional price with a capped financial exposure.

task_fulfillment.rationale: While the deliverable is well-structured, comprehensive, and appropriately frames unstated thresholds as proposals, it contains a direct internal contradiction and governance violation on a critical requirement (R15): Section 2 Governance Rule R3 states that 'Nomination is signed off by Quality, ER and the Program Manager; Finance is informed after nomination,' whereas the prompt and Section 4 (Stage S5) require Finance sign-off at nomination.

evidence.output_quote: Nomination is signed off by Quality, ER and the Program Manager; Finance is informed after nomination. Purchase compiles and owns the nomination file.
